summary: The proposal is missing the required Abstract section, exceeds the allowed length, and contains several critical content issues such as presenting a solution within the Problem section. Major problems include a double‑verb objective description, missing AI‑transparency verification, and a schedule that includes thesis writing tasks. Minor issues affect figure captions, citation formatting, and spelling consistency.

findings.title: Missing Abstract Section
findings.description: The proposal does not contain an Abstract section, which is required by the guidelines.

findings.title: Proposal Exceeds Allowed Length
findings.description: The document spans more than the permitted 4–6 pages of text, making it too long for the proposal format.

findings.title: Problem Section Contains Solution Description
findings.description: The Problem section should only describe the problem and its negative consequences, but it proposes a self‑service platform as a solution.

locations.quote: A self‑service platform that arms the workflow engine of Keycloak with an expiry date at grant time would **end this accumulation**.

findings.title: Problem Section Too Long
findings.description: The Problem section exceeds the allowed maximum of three‑quarters of a page.

locations.quote: The current process doesn’t scale and is the **worst bottleneck** of the chair.

findings.title: Objective Bullet Uses Double Verb
findings.description: Objective 2 is phrased as "Design and implement connectors with expiry", which contains two verbs and violates the single‑verb rule.

findings.title: AI Transparency Statement Missing Confirmation
findings.description: The AI transparency statement does not include a sentence confirming that the author has carefully checked all AI‑generated text.

locations.quote: I used the following generative artificial intelligence (AI) tool while preparing this proposal.

findings.title: Schedule Includes Thesis Writing Task
findings.description: Iteration 7 lists "Write the thesis and prepare the final presentation", which is prohibited in the schedule according to the guidelines.

locations.quote: •   Iteration 7 (18–31 March): **Write the thesis** and prepare the final presentation.

findings.title: Figure 2 Caption Too Short
findings.description: The caption for Figure 2 is only "System Architecture", which is insufficiently descriptive.

findings.title: Inline URLs Not Presented as Footnotes
findings.description: Non‑peer‑reviewed URLs are embedded directly in the text instead of being formatted as footnotes.

findings.title: Spelling Inconsistency of "recertifcation"
findings.description: The word "recertifcation" is misspelled; the correct spelling is "recertification", leading to inconsistency.

locations.quote: The platform logs every change … **recertifcation** interval …
